5.Sub-event_summary: Definition and strategic importance of the lodgment area as a prerequisite for the main offensive into Germany, including its geographic boundaries, advantages, and key ports.

5.Sub-event_summary: On 11 August, Montgomery outlined encircling Germans west of Caen-Falaise-Argentan-Alençon-le Mans line by narrowing the supply gap; anticipating German reactions, he ordered Canadians to capture Falaise quickly then Argentan, British to advance toward Falaise, and XV Corps to Alençon at the boundary, potentially destroying forces between Seine and Loire or pursuing to Seine if evaded.
